title: Crystal-lattice probe of $q$
html: A periodic crystal lattice acts as a macroscopic, coherent probe of the local value q|_U established in local substrate q. The discrete translational symmetry of the lattice isolates a set of reciprocal vectors that couple directly to the horizontal distribution of the CR manifold M. Where the lattice spacing is commensurate with the characteristic scale of a q-torsion leaf (q-torsion leaf), a resonance condition triggers. The q-harmonic forms (q-harmonic form) on the brane constructively interfere with the crystal's phonon modes, amplifying vacuum fluctuations at specific frequencies. The resonance frequency \nu_{\mathrm{res}} depends entirely on q|_U and lattice geometry. This supplies an independent experimental route to measure the substrate parameter.
